name: Hackney

applications.description: Outline planning application (all matters reserved with the exception of access) for the redevelopment and master planning of a residential-led development of Phases 5-8 (inclusive) of the Woodberry Down Estate for up to 3,083 homes (C3 Use Class), up to 950m2 Non Residential Uses (F2 'Local Community Use' Use Class) and up to 300m2 Energy Centre (Sui Generis), This is to also include associated landscaping, open space, play provision, public realm and servicing. (THIS APPLICATION IS ACCOMPANIED BY AN ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT)

game.plainAsk: Rebuild Woodberry Down phases 5 to 8: up to 3,083 homes. 43% would be affordable — as a maximum 1,325 affordable homes (583 of those are social rent).
game.plainImpact: Hackney's planning sub-committee granted this outline with a 43% affordable target. Housing Delivery Test 2025: 52%. Hackney has 3,684 households in temporary accommodation (31 March 2026).
game.affordableNote: 43% AH; max 1,325 affordable (583 social rent). Hackney committee 2024/2817. https://hackney.moderngov.co.uk/ieListDocuments.aspx?MId=6122
game.boroughImpact: Housing Delivery Test 2025: 52%. Hackney has 3,684 households in temporary accommodation (31 March 2026). https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/housing-delivery-test-2025-measurement https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/live-tables-on-homelessness

applications.description: Variation of condition 1 (Approved Plans) of the Colville Estate regeneration Outline Planning Permission 2011/0734 (as amended by 2013/4025 and 2021/1406) for “The demolition of the existing buildings comprising of 412 dwellings and 406 sq.m (Gross Internal Area) of non-residential floorspace, and the development of a residential led mixed use scheme of replacement buildings comprising of: Residential (Use Class C3) up to 884 dwellings, of which up to 1,010 sq.m (GIA) can be Business (Use Class B1); Mixed use of Retail (Use Class A1), Financial and professional services (Use Class A2), Restaurants and café (Use Class A3), Drinking establishments (Use Class A4), Hot food takeaways (Use Class A5), Community/Health uses (Use Class D1), and Assembly and leisure (Use Class D2) up to 950 sq.m (GIA); Vehicular and cycle parking (to basement, semi-basement, under-croft and surface level); Together with associated areas of open space, hard and soft landscaping; alterations to new pedestrian and vehicular accesses and highway and engineering works; electricity sub-station and other utility requirements, including an energy centre; and other associated temporary works or structures.” The amendments would be to the approved parameter plans and include increased maximum building heights at plot G (one metre) and H (80 cm); changes to the estate-wide access and public realm framework; changes to balcony provision zones where projecting balconies are permitted; changes to the defensible frontage to new dwellings; a reduced courtyard to plot G with increased public realm; increased building depths at plots G and H; updated existing tree protection arrangements.

game.plainAsk: A height and layout tweak to the Colville Estate regeneration. The parent permission is for up to 884 homes. The 2011 legal agreement says no less than 50% affordable by habitable room.
game.plainImpact: This 2026 application only varies heights and parameter plans. Affordable housing stays the parent S106 floor of 50% by habitable room. Housing Delivery Test 2025: 52%. Hackney has 3,684 households in temporary accommodation (31 March 2026).
game.affordableNote: Parent 2011/0734 S106: no less than 50% AH by habitable room. This 2026 row is a height/parameter tweak, not a new tenure offer. https://hackney.moderngov.co.uk/mgAi.aspx?ID=9965

applications.description: Redevelopment of existing self-storage site (B8 use) to provide a mixed use scheme comprising blocks of 2-7 storeys and accommodating a self-storage facility (Use Class B8) at lower basement, basement and ground floor level, office accommodation (Use Class E(g)) at basement, ground and first floor level, 139 residential units (Use Class C3) at second to sixth floor and cafe (Use Class E) at ground and first floor level, along with landscaping and other associated works.

game.plainImpact: 139 homes, The application doesn't say how many would be social homes. Royal London Hospital is a hike. Street-crime count in May 2026 is high (2187 within 400 m, locations approximate). This borough's 2023–24 affordable pace was 70.

applications.description: Demolition of existing garage and construction of a new 6-storey 28 unit (13 x 2-bed & 15 x 3-bed) residential block (C3 use class) with associated amenity space and child playspace, cycle parking, refuse stores, hard and soft landscaping, playspace, public realm works and on-street Blue Badge parking.

game.plainImpact: 28 homes. The public record we have does not state a social-housing figure. Housing Delivery Test 2025: 52%. Hackney has 3,684 households in temporary accommodation (31 March 2026).
